title: Payout Methods Transfer Terms
content:
These terms govern every transfer from a Payout Methods undisbursed balance to the host's account, card or receiver profile on a payout method. For each rail, the figures that apply are that rail's own percentage fee, fixed fee, highest percentage fee per transfer and processing time, as the rail schedules set them.

## Terms in force

**T1 — Currency.** Transfers are made in USD or in the method's payout currency at the rail's conversion rate (the Roamhaven daily conversion rate on the transfer date).

**T2 — Method status.** A transfer is sent only to an active payout method. The method's status on its own record is the evidence; a method pending verification, on hold or removed receives no transfer.

**T3 — Host account status.** No transfer is sent while the host account's status is suspended. The host account record is the evidence; an account that is active, restricted or deactivated is not stopped by this term.

**T4 — New-method period.** Transfers to a newly verified method start only the rail's new-method hold period in calendar days after its verification date; the days are counted from the verification date on the method's record, and a transfer on the first day after the period is allowed.

**T5 — Minimum and maximum.** An amount below the rail's smallest transfer waits in the balance until the balance reaches the minimum; an amount above the rail's largest single transfer is split into consecutive transfers of at most the maximum on the same day.

**T6 — Fees.** Fees are rounded to the nearest cent, half up, and taken from the balance.

**T7 — Arrival.** Funds arrive within the rail's processing time in business days on the US Federal Reserve holiday calendar; a transfer after the 17:00 US Eastern cut-off starts the next business day.

### T4 boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Rail and new-method period | Verification date on the method record | Transfer date considered | Allowed under T4? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Direct Deposit (ACH), 5 calendar days | 2026-03-02 | 2026-03-06 | No: within the period |
| Direct Deposit (ACH), 5 calendar days | 2026-03-02 | 2026-03-07 | Yes: 5 calendar days after verification |
| PayPal, 3 calendar days | 2026-03-02 | 2026-03-05 | Yes: 3 calendar days after verification |

### Conditions a transfer must meet together

| Method active (T2) | Host account not suspended (T3) | New-method period passed (T4) | Transfer sent |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes, subject to T5 |
| No | any | any | No |
| any | No | any | No |
| any | any | No | No |

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of these terms are **no longer in force**. Each has been superseded by the current basis the company applies to the matter it covered, and none of them is applied to any transfer:

- *"Released earnings and credits are transferred to their method after withholding and deductions."* No longer in force.
- *"Each transfer is charged the rail's percentage fee of the transfer (cut to the rail's highest percentage fee where a cap above 0.00 applies) plus the rail's fixed fee as one transfer fee"*, together with its rounding of that sum to the cent. No longer in force.
- *"When the payout currency is not USD, the rail's cross-currency fee percentage (cut to the rail's highest cross-currency fee where above 0.00) as a separate cross-currency fee."* No longer in force.
